name: Explosive Dinosaurs
description:
+40 FUN COMPETITIVE MINIGAMES FEATURING DINOS AND EXPLOSIONS!

Want to challenge your friends and have a blast?
The goal is simple: Compete and have fun! 

Features:
· Up to 4 players.
· +40 unique multiplayer minigames for all ages to enjoy with friends & family.
· No random winners, all minigames require skill!
· PREHISTORY MODE: Play solo or with a friend to unlock new minigames.
· TEAM MODE (2v2): One teammate wins the minigame while the other sabotages the other team.
· CRAZY ARCADE CHALLENGE: Endless minigames, only one try—good luck!
· CHILD MODE: An easy difficulty mode for training newcomers!

TL;DR: Pizza, 4 controllers, 3 pals, and blew the competition away!
